notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Haliya triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
